subject: SIG evidence: consolidated matrix, remediation log, and portal links
messages:
From: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@blueharbormed.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: SIG follow-up: remaining artifacts and timeline

Vanessa / Marissa,

Thanks for the quick reconnaissance call yesterday. To keep BlueHarbor's procurement moving, we need a tight deliverable list for the SIG review. At a minimum our security and procurement teams require:

- SOC 2 Type II report (most recent 12 months) or a SOC 2 summary if full report is redacted
- Executive summary of last pen test with high/critical findings and remediation status
- ISO statements (if available) or attestation language
- Security deck for an executive readout (10-12 slides)
- Completed SIG evidence matrix or a point of contact for backlog items

Can you confirm which of the above you can share by EOD Friday (6/4)? Also include a secure link for artifacts (S3 / Drive / portal) and any NDA steps if required.

Appreciate it — we need to present to legal next Monday.

Best,
Alex Monroe
Head of Security Partnerships
BlueHarbor Medical
alex.monroe@blueharbormed.com


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@blueharbormed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: remaining artifacts and timeline

Alex — thanks for the clear list. We're assembling a single evidence matrix and action log so you can track items that are ready, in progress, or require an NDA/redaction. High-level status below and I attached the matrix and planned artifacts.

Summary status (short):
- SOC 2: we can provide a SOC 2 Type II summary and an auditor attestation. Full report is available under NDA; summary attached.
- Pen test: exec summary attached. No outstanding critical issues; two medium findings were remediated in Q1 and are listed in the action log.
- ISO: we do not hold ISO certs; we can provide our ISO control mappings and statements of intent for audits.
- Security deck: attached (redwood-security-deck-2027.pptx).

Attachments included: sig-evidence-matrix-20270607.xlsx, redwood_soc2-summary-2027.pdf, pen_test-exec-summary-2027.pdf, redwood-security-deck-2027.pptx

Next steps / asks:
1) I'll upload the same files to a secure portal and share the link (expect it within 24 hours).
2) If you need the full SOC report, please confirm PoP and we'll provide a DocuSign NDA (I can loop legal).
3) Marissa will own any commercial redlines tied to data retention and SSO requirements. Marcus will own technical clarifications.

We aim to have the portal link and remediation log by Friday EOD. If that doesn't work for your timeline, tell us the critical must-have and we'll prioritize.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Alex Monroe <alex.monroe@blueharbormed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: remaining artifacts and timeline

Alex, Vanessa — quick technical clarifications and remediation log excerpt below.

Pen test notes:
- Executive summary (attached) lists two medium findings: transient auth token leakage (identified Nov 2026, fixed Dec 2026) and outdated third-party dependency (patched Mar 2027). Both have verification steps in the action log.
- No open high/critical findings to disclose.

SOC 2 / redaction guidance:
- We can provide a SOC 2 redacted report under NDA. The summary includes control families, coverage period (11/01/2025 - 10/31/2026), the auditor name, and whether any exceptions were noted.
- For procurement teams that require evidence of continuous monitoring, we also have an internal control dashboard snapshot (screenshot) we can include.

Remediation / action log (short):
- RDW-AUTH-021: token expiry hardening — completed 2026-12-15 — verification: integration test batch 2027-02-02
- RDW-DEP-104: dependency CVE-2027-001 — patched 2027-03-10 — verification: SCA scan 2027-03-12

I'll post a cleaned view of the remediation log to the portal. If BlueHarbor wants a timestamped artifact (hash or signed attest), we can provide that as well.

Marcus Lin
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Thanks — that looks good. Two quick items before we close out:

1) Please share the secure portal link and I’ll confirm access for my procurement and engineering stakeholders.
2) We prefer the SOC 2 summary for initial review; if legal asks for the full report, I’ll send the signed NDA link back to you.

If you can paste the portal link in this thread and the DocuSign link for the NDA, I’ll triage tomorrow. Appreciate the clear action log and attachments.

Best,
Alex
